verses.text_en: And after those days in that place where I had seen all the visions of that which is hidden—for I had been carried off in a whirlwind and they had borne me towards the west—
verses.text_hr: Nakon tih dana, na mjestu gdje sam vidio sva viđenja onoga što je skriveno — jer me vihor odnio i ponio prema zapadu —

verses.text_en: There mine eyes saw all the secret things of heaven that shall be, a mountain of iron, and a mountain of copper, and a mountain of silver, and a mountain of gold, and a mountain of soft metal, and a mountain of lead.
verses.text_hr: ondje su moje oči vidjele sve buduće tajne nebesa: planinu od željeza, planinu od bakra, planinu od srebra, planinu od zlata, planinu od meke kovine i planinu od olova.

verses.text_en: And I asked the angel who went with me, saying, ‘What things are these which I have seen in secret?’
verses.text_hr: Upitao sam anđela koji je išao sa mnom: „Što je to što sam vidio u skrovitosti?“

verses.text_en: And he said unto me: ‘All these things which thou hast seen shall serve the dominion of His Anointed that he may be potent and mighty on the earth.’
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio mi je: „Sve što si vidio služit će vlasti njegova Pomazanika, da bude silan i moćan na zemlji.“

verses.text_en: And that angel of peace answered, saying unto me: ‘Wait a little and there shall be revealed unto thee all the secret things, which surround the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr: Anđeo mira rekao mi je: „Pričekaj malo i bit će ti otkrivene sve tajne koje okružuju Gospodara duhova.

verses.text_en:
And these mountains which thine eyes have seen, The mountain of iron, and the mountain of copper, and the mountain of silver,
And the mountain of gold, and the mountain of soft metal, and the mountain of lead,
All these shall be in the presence of the Elect One,
As wax before the fire,
And like the water which streams down from above [upon those mountains],
And they shall become powerless before his feet.
verses.text_hr:
Ove planine koje su tvoje oči vidjele — planina od željeza, planina od bakra, planina od srebra,
planina od zlata, planina od meke kovine i planina od olova —
sve će one pred Izabranim biti
poput voska pred vatrom
i poput vode koja odozgo teče [niz te planine];
pred njegovim će nogama izgubiti svu snagu.

verses.text_en:
And it shall come to pass in those days that none shall be saved,
Either by gold or by silver,
And none be able to escape.
verses.text_hr:
U one se dane nitko neće spasiti
ni zlatom ni srebrom
i nitko neće moći umaći.

verses.text_en:
And there shall be no iron for war,
Nor shall one clothe oneself with a breastplate.
Bronze shall be of no service,
And tin [shall be of no service and] shall not be esteemed,
And lead shall not be desired.
verses.text_hr:
Neće biti željeza za rat
niti će se tko odjenuti u oklop.
Bronca neće biti ni od kakve koristi,
a kositar [neće biti ni od kakve koristi i] neće se cijeniti;
olovo neće biti poželjno.

verses.text_en:
And all these things shall be [denied and] destroyed from the surface of the earth,
When the Elect One shall appear before the face of the Lord of Spirits.’
verses.text_hr:
Sve će to biti [odbačeno i] uništeno s lica zemlje
kad se Izabrani pojavi pred licem Gospodara duhova.“
